seams.abi: EAX=record ECX=next EDX=ID ESP=S; signed input[S+4]; local success EAX0/failure negative maps through original Boolean tail, caller cleans4
ESI=current EBP=cached-next EBX0 ESP=T=S-16; cancel locally, preserve records/stack; original clears playing, conditionally status1 callback, then clears keys and follows next

rate_domain: All positive signed inputs1..INT_MAX; exact float bits0x3727c5ac. Nonpositive rejects without mutation. Ownership/transaction failures are separate, not positive-rate caps.
preservation: Both owned and unowned injected work preserves x87 stack/control/status, MXCSR/XMM, nonvolatile registers, four-byte stack contract and LastError. Unowned restores all incoming GPR/flags before original replay.
ownership: Explicit live record/shell identity and generation; flags8 or ID2 alone insufficient. Owned unsupported/stale state must never fall through to original COM.
limits: Candidate spans only; no hook installation/CPU/unwind/runtime qualification or complete media integration. Mixed lists still hold current/cached-next through unowned COM/callbacks. Thread/alias/exception/lifetime and cancellation-capacity obligations remain.
